analyst: The size of the move is not measured until price moves more than impulse_ticks inside impulse_minutes. On the 2-minute ES chart that starts at more than 250 ticks in 15 minutes, which is the last 8 bars. A tick is tick_size. ES is 0.25, so 250 ticks is 62.5 points. After that burst, the measured high and low extend with the move. move_points is how large that move must be. That move has to finish within move_minutes of the burst. It starts at 45 minutes. A new high or low after that window means the move was still going, so it is not traded. After a move up, a later bar that trades within retest_points of the high and closes back down is the short. After a move down, a later bar that bounces within retest_points of the low and closes up is the buy. The trade fades the move. The stop is stop_dollars. The take profit is tp_dollars. The position is flat outside the New York session. Realized profit of daily_profit_cap, or a realized loss of daily_loss_cap, stops new trades until the next session. Cooldown bars must pass after a trade closes before the next entry.
